nodes.label: Isolated AI Reasoning Layer
nodes.rationale: Untrusted email content is isolated in XML tags with schema enforcement to avoid prompt injection escapes.

nodes.label: Threat: Prompt Injection in Email Content
nodes.norm_label: threat: prompt injection in email content
nodes.rationale: Attacker crafts malicious instruction text inside email body trying to override LLM system instructions.

nodes.label: Deterministic Heuristics Engine
nodes.rationale: Levenshtein distance <= 2 for typosquatting checks and link anchor mismatch checks provide immediate fast signals before AI inference.

nodes.label: Ingestion & Analysis Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Multer 5MB stream limit to prevent memory exhaustion DoS before parsing.

nodes.label: Supabase RLS Tenant Isolation
nodes.rationale: Database Row Level Security policies enforce multi-tenant isolation at the PostgreSQL layer.

nodes.label: System Architecture Overview
nodes.rationale: Layered defense-in-depth architecture to inspect phishing threats safely without rendering raw HTML or executing instructions.

nodes.label: Defense in Depth Security Principles
nodes.rationale: Zero raw rendering, strict CORS, Helmet headers, and schema validation.

nodes.label: Threat: Malicious Large Payload DoS
nodes.rationale: Buffer exhaustion attacks through multi-gigabyte email uploads mitigated by 5MB stream cutoff.
